harmaline.definition:
n. An alkaloid found in the plant Peganum harmala. It forms
   bitter, yellow salts.
harmaline.translation: n. [药]二氢骆驼蓬碱 , 哈马灵

harmalol.translation:
[化] 哈梅洛尔; 哈马洛尔
[医] 哈马洛, 去甲二氢骆驼蓬硷

harmattan.definition: n. a dusty wind from the Sahara that blows toward the western coast of Africa during the winter

harmed.translation: v. （使）受到损害, 伤害( harm的过去式和过去分词 )

harmel.definition:
n. A kind of rue (Ruta sylvestris) growing in India. At Lahore
   the seeds are used medicinally and for fumigation.
harmel.translation: 哈美骆驼蓬, 肉叶芸香

harmful.definition: a. causing or capable of causing harm
harmful.translation: a. 有害的, 伤害的

n. destructiveness that causes harm or injury
n. the quality of being noxious

harmine.definition:
n. An alkaloid accompanying harmaline (in the Peganum
   harmala), and obtained from it by oxidation. It is a white crystalline
   substance.
harmine.translation: n. [药]骆驼蓬碱,肉叶芸香碱

harmless.translation:

[法] 无害的, 无恶意的, 无损害的

harmonic.definition:
n. a tone that is a component of a complex sound
n. any of a series of musical tones whose frequencies are integral multiples of the frequency of a fundamental
a. of or relating to harmony as distinct from melody and rhythm

a. 和谐的, 音乐般的, 和声的
